target_customer: Hospitals and health systems that run third party medical imaging AI in production (radiology leadership, CMIOs, AI governance leads)
problem: Once an imaging AI model is live in a hospital, few teams can show whether it still agrees with radiologists, has drifted, or performs evenly across patient groups. Governance and compliance teams need evidence of continuous monitoring.
business_model: B2B software sold to health systems, pilot first; pricing not public

founders.name: Christine Park
founders.background_notes: YC page states neurosurgery training at the University of Washington. A directory notes that other bios of a Christine Park from Duke are not confirmed to be the same person, but the YC page itself states the Duke degrees.

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingests HL7 and DICOM feeds on premises, computes drift and subgroup metrics and produces signed offline verifiable reports. Hospital integration is the hard part for a one person team.

defensibility.rationale: Metrics are well known from the literature and professional guidance, so the method is copyable. Hospital integrations and trust could become switching costs, but there are no customers named yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know. Platforms and professional bodies were already publishing monitoring frameworks in 2026.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites FDA, ONC and ACR expectations for continuous post deployment monitoring. A 2026 ACR practice parameter and an RCR monitoring document (March 2026) and a Stanford HAI brief (May 2026) all call for monitoring of deployed clinical AI.

branding.domain_note: Uses latticehealthai.com, not an exact .com match for the name; no purchase details found.

identity.logo: A logo image exists on directory listings but no source describes it
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain regulatory language: observes rather than controls, evidence for safety and compliance

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found. The name is shared with the well known HR software company Lattice and several other health firms, which makes search harder.

outcome_analysis: Lattice Health is a Spring 2026 company with a single founder and no public customers, funding or outcome yet. The timing tailwind from FDA, ONC and ACR monitoring expectations is real, but a solo founder faces hospital sales cycles and professional society programs.
